title: Constructive equivalence between Brouwer's fixed-point theorem and weak König's lemma
summary: In the context of constructive reverse mathematics, we show that Brouwer's fixed-point theorem and weak König's lemma (WKL) are equivalent. To derive WKL from Brouwer's fixed-point theorem, the construction of a continuous function on the unit square without fixed points due to Orevkov [Soviet Math. Doklady (1963), 1253--1256] is generalised to yield a uniformly continuous function on the unit square whose fixed points encode information about infinite paths of a given infinite tree.
